lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate integration sleeps to waitForCondition (group A: tmux-introspect, stop-sidecar-real)

nextStoryContext: US-002 migrated all 13 Bun.sleepSync sites (12 in test/integration/tmux-introspect.test.ts, 1 in test/integration/stop-sidecar-real.test.ts) to waitForCondition (test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts, already on main from CAM-62). Every site had a genuinely pollable real condition; zero bare-sleep tracker-ref suppressions were needed in this group. Two small local helpers were added directly in tmux-introspect.test.ts (not exported/shared, since stop-sidecar-real.test.ts only needed the pre-existing has-session check): `paneLabel(paneTarget)` runs `tmux display-message -p -t <paneTarget> '#{@cam_label}'` and returns the trimmed stdout (poll target for 'label is set to X'); `paneIds(sessionName)` runs `tmux list-panes -t <sessionName> -F '#{pane_id}'` and returns the trimmed non-empty lines as an array (poll target for 'pane count is N' or 'pane id X is present/absent'). Session/pane creation polls `has-session -t <name>` (exit 0) or `paneIds(...).length === N`; a kill-pane polls `!paneIds(...).includes(deadId)`. All `beforeEach`/test callbacks touching these sites became `async` (bun:test supports this natively) to `await waitForCondition(predicate)`. Verified real (not faked): `bun test test/integration/tmux-introspect.test.ts` -> 5 pass, `bun test test/integration/stop-sidecar-real.test.ts` -> 2 pass, full `bun test` -> 4591 pass / 0 fail, full `bun run check:all` -> exit 0 (all 11 gates ok). Two file-size ceilings were raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json to the gate's exact reported line counts (tmux-introspect.test.ts 185->209, stop-sidecar-real.test.ts 240->241) with a dated CAM-305 _ref note, staged in the same commit as the test changes. US-003 (group B: test/integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts, test/integration/worker-pane-geometry.test.ts per the sequential PRD numbering) is the next story in this same migration series -- reuse the exact same helper shape (display-message for label polling, list-panes -F '#{pane_id}' for pane-existence/count polling) rather than re-deriving it; check each new file's own pane/label/file-artifact vocabulary since the exact tmux subcommands invoked may differ (e.g. review-verdict-handback likely also polls for a written review-report.json file via Bun.file(path).exists() per the PRD notes, not just tmux state).

officialDocsValidated.summary: display-message -p writes to stdout instead of the status line; -t <target-pane> sources #{...} format variables (including custom @-prefixed user options like @cam_label) from that specific pane. Confirmed the new paneLabel() helper's argv shape (['display-message','-p','-t',paneTarget,'#{@cam_label}']) matches documented behavior; also verified empirically via the passing real-tmux test run (5/5 pass), not doc-only.
